purpose: Brief 7.6. The claims gate refuses /more Neanderthal than/i and /Neanderthal (percentile|rank|score)/i on every user-visible surface. Two sentences are meant to be exempt: the refusal sentence on /science/limits and the no-ranking sentence on /science#ancestry. They are pinned here by full sentence, never by file glob, and each may occur exactly once in the whole scanned tree.
empty_because: Neither sentence has been written. Until 2026-10-22 the estimate they qualify was unbuilt; since then it ships under TEST-LOCAL only (src/lib/genome/neanderthal-availability.ts), production off, and neither /science page sentence has been written or reviewed. Pinning a sentence that does not exist would be inventing the wording of a refusal. The list stays empty, which makes the rule strictly stronger — no occurrence is permitted anywhere, including on the Neanderthal card — and the two entries are added by whoever writes those pages.
